question: The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Bill, 2021 is related to ________ Ministry of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Environment, Forests & Climate Change.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Minitsry of Environment, Forests & Climate Change:-**

 
 
• **The MoEFCC is the nodal ministry of the Government of India for the conservation and sustainable management of natural resources. **
 
• It is responsible for the formulation and implementation of policies and programmes related to environment, forests, wildlife, and climate change.
 
• **The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Bill, 2021 is related to the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) of India. (Hence option 4 is correct)**
 
 
 
• **The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Bill, 2021:-**
 
 
• It seeks to amend the Biological Diversity Act, 2002.
 
• **The Act is aimed at protecting the biological diversity of the country and providing for the sustainable use of its biological resources. **
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare:-**

 
 
• MoA&FW is a branch of the Government of India and the apex body for formulation and administration of the rules and regulations and laws related to agriculture in India.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Corporate Affairs:-**
 
 
• MCA is an Indian government ministry primarily concerned with administration of the Companies Act 2013, the Companies Act 1956, the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008, and the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Earth Sciences:-**
 
 
• MoES is a branch of the Government of India responsible for the development of earth system science in the country.
 
• It was formed in 2006 by merging the Department of Ocean Development with the India Meteorological Department, the National Centre for Medium Range Weather Forecasting, and the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology.
